title: Apple Stock: Why I'm Still Not Running With the Bulls
text:
Apple Stock: Why I'm Still Not Running With the Bulls By 0
Apple Inc. (AAPL) is due to report earnings after the close Tuesday. I am sure that they will be closely watched. AAPL closed higher Monday and is opening higher today. We last checked the charts in early April, writing that "AAPL eventually recovered from its February test of the 200-day line. It could do it again or maybe now the weaker market conditions will dominate. We'll have to see but again I do not like the risk/reward profile I see on AAPL."
Looking back over the past four weeks of price action we can see that Action Alerts PLUS holding AAPL recovered from its test of the 200-day line but reversed to the downside in mid-month and made new lows for the move down last week ahead of the numbers tonight.
